name: Vigilant Heavy Gunner, Maul arc-cannon
revision: 0.1 · resin figure, helm, backpack and 32 mm base
description: A Vigilant heavy gunner braced in a wide stance, firing the Maul arc-cannon from the hip: rear grip in the right fist, left fist on the carry handle, a power cable sweeping from the capacitor drum to a cell on the belt. Helm and backpack are separate keyed parts.
buildNotes: Same Kestrel exosuit kit as the line (tools/exosuit.py); this figure adds the Maul arc-cannon, a swept power cable and a belt power cell.
The Maul is about 16 mm long; its three emitter rails are 0.9 mm round and braced by two rings, so none is a free-standing wire.
Integral 1.1 mm footplate keyed into the base recess; helm (1.6 mm) and backpack (2.0 mm) on D-flat pegs from miniature_base_and_peg.
Prints: figure tilted on supports at the angle miniature_support_plan picked; base flat on the plate.
limitations: Procedural sculpt, not a hand sculpt: smooth armour faces, gauntlet fists. The cannon overhangs the base edge by design. Printability is a heuristic screen through unified-CAD-MCP, not a test print; the STEP is a faceted reference.
